target: Mean pupil radius over final0.25s of horizon1s
timing_contract: Predict1s-ahead author-released pupil radius from prior pupil and treadmill samples. Source prior filtering may be noncausal; causal-prefix guarantee applies to released traces only, not original camera pixels.
calibration: No held-target calibration; observed past5s from each session supplies history. Pixel units are retained without invented millimeter scaling.
independent_unit: Animal, all sessions linked; two development animals and one reserved animal

reference.equation: max(0,p); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

baseline_persistence.equation: max(0,p); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

baseline_velocity.equation: max(0,p+v); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

baseline_flexible.equation: max(0,p+b0+sum_j b_j exp(-mean((z-center_j)^2)/2)); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

attempt_001_relaxation.equation: max(0,p+b0*r); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

attempt_002_inertia.equation: max(0,p+b0*r+b1*v); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

attempt_003_arousal.equation: max(0,p+b0*r+b1*v+b2*u+b3*du); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

attempt_004_asymmetry.equation: max(0,p+b0*r+b1*max(v,0)+b2*min(v,0)); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

attempt_005_curvature.equation: max(0,p+b0*r+b1*v+b2*a); p=current quarter-second radius(px), r=preceding5s mean-p, v=2*(p-p_t-0.5s), a=p-2*p_t-0.5s+p_t-1s, u=ln(1+speed/(1cm/s)),du=u-u_t-1s. Coefficients of pixel features dimensionless; u/du coefficients px.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Show every group and matched-baseline difference. Few groups/dates do not justify narrow population confidence intervals; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: Only three retained animals. Optical pixel calibration differs by animal/session; source ACh-M1/V1 recordings confound region and animal. No retinal physiology or real-time instrument claim.

exposure.historical_record: Public source-aware corpus; internally reserved confirmation opened only after candidate/selection/stopping freeze. Outcomes now exposed to future users. This is computational confirmation, not independent experimental replication.

scope: One middle eligible forecast origin from every native recording/session with at least one eligible origin; all currently exposed partitions covered.
native_prefix_audit.limits: Released-product prefix invariance at tested origins; not a proof of publisher upstream processing causality or every possible mutation.
